description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求之间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of requests and prevent repeated requests from being submitted. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.
